:::{#thm-bernoulli-loglik-one-group}
#### Log-likelihood of binary outcomes with one event probability

Let $\Outvar_\iobs \simind \Ber(\prob)$ for $i = 1, \dots, n$,
with observed outcomes $\vy \eqdef (\dsn{y})$, each $\outvar_\iobs \in \cb{0, 1}$.
The log-likelihood $\llik(\prob; \vy)$ of the event probability $\prob$,
written with the log-odds $\logodds \eqdef \logit(\prob)$, is:

$$\llik(\prob; \vy) = \paren{\sumin \outvar_\iobs} \logodds + n \logf{1 - \prob}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-loglik-one-group, worked in @sol-bernoulli-loglik-one-group.
It builds on @thm-bernoulli-likelihood-one-group.

:::
